keyVerseDR: "And rising very early, going out, he went into a desert place: and there he prayed." (Mk 1:35)

level1.title: Jesus Heals and Prays
level1.story: Jesus healed Peter's mother-in-law of a fever. That night many sick people came, and He healed them. Early in the morning, Jesus went off alone to pray.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
level1.prayer: Jesus, teach me to pray. Amen.

activity.title: My prayer time
activity.intro: Jesus prayed early in the morning. Draw your prayer time on the clock.

level2.title: A Day in Capernaum
level2.story: Jesus went to the house of Simon and Andrew, where Simon's mother-in-law was sick with a fever. He took her by the hand and lifted her up, and the fever left her, and she served them. That evening, the whole city gathered at the door, and Jesus healed many sick people. Very early in the morning, He went to a lonely place to pray. When the disciples found Him, He said, "Let us go into the neighbouring towns, that I may preach there also."
level2.keyLine: Rising very early, he went into a desert place: and there he prayed.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did Jesus pray even when busy?
What did the healed woman do right away?
level2.prayer: Jesus, help me pray and serve like You. Amen.

activity.intro: Jesus made time to pray. Check your evening examen.
